// docs: The documented path for the local stack is a task, not a remembered
command line: every compose invocation needs both --env-file flags and the
right -f chain, and getting either wrong fails in a way that looks like a
broken stack rather than a wrong command.
docs/SPEC.md §42. The stack is local only — no deploy tasks exist because
there is no deployment path in this repository.

tasks.label: stack:up
tasks.detail: Bring up Postgres, MinIO, Redis and the api/web from source (hot reload).
tasks.command: docker compose --env-file docker/env/base.env --env-file docker/env/local.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml up -d --build

tasks.label: stack:up (services only)
tasks.detail: Postgres, MinIO and Redis only — for running the api and web on the host with `pnpm dev`.
tasks.command: docker compose --env-file docker/env/base.env --env-file docker/env/local.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d

tasks.label: stack:down
tasks.command: docker compose --env-file docker/env/base.env --env-file docker/env/local.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml down

tasks.label: stack:reset
tasks.detail: Stop the stack and DELETE its volumes — database, object storage and cache.
tasks.command: docker compose --env-file docker/env/base.env --env-file docker/env/local.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml down -v

tasks.label: stack:logs
tasks.detail: Follow the api and web logs.
tasks.command: docker compose --env-file docker/env/base.env --env-file docker/env/local.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml logs -f api web

tasks.label: stack:debug
tasks.detail: Bring the stack up with the Bun inspector on the api (attach to localhost:6500).
tasks.command: docker compose --env-file docker/env/base.env --env-file docker/env/local.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f docker/docker-compose.debug.yml up -d --build

tasks.label: db:init
tasks.detail: One-shot: apply migrations, run the seed, create the MinIO buckets. Idempotent.
tasks.command: docker compose --env-file docker/env/base.env --env-file docker/env/local.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.seed.yml --profile seed up --abort-on-container-exit

tasks.label: db:migrate (container)
tasks.detail: Apply pending migrations inside the api container, through praxis-task.
tasks.command: docker compose --env-file docker/env/base.env --env-file docker/env/local.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml exec api praxis-task migrate

tasks.label: db:seed (container)
tasks.detail: Run the seed inside the api container, through praxis-task. Idempotent.
tasks.command: docker compose --env-file docker/env/base.env --env-file docker/env/local.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml exec api praxis-task seed

tasks.label: health
tasks.detail: Check the api's health endpoint through the published port.

tasks.label: verify (lint, typecheck, test)
tasks.detail: What the pre-push hook runs, minus the database suites.
tasks.command: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
